note: Which risk area's assessor may attest an answer about a control family (FR-17). Versioned because it decides ACCOUNTABILITY — who is answerable for signing off what — and that is an owner decision, not a rendering choice. A family with no mapping falls to the generalist rather than to nobody.

families.because: model governance, oversight, bias and explainability are the AI area's own subject
communications compliance, cross-border and statutory reporting are legal obligations
encryption, minimisation, retention and secrets are how data is protected
oversight and approval are governance's subject by name
screening and training are about the people doing the work
who can reach what is a security control, not a privacy one
event logging and monitoring are detective security controls
boundary protection, WAF, API security and availability are the perimeter
documented procedures and quality control are operational discipline
personal-information handling is the privacy office's subject
backup, incident response and continuity are about keeping it running
vulnerability management, pen testing and patching belong to how the thing is built
supplier access, contracts and fourth parties are the third-party area's own subject
